name: A Recipe For Death
summary: In Silverpine, A Recipe For Death gathers reagents for the Forsaken's New Plague. Apothecary Renferrel sends bear hearts and spider blood from the Sepulcher to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

sections.title: A Weapon Against Two Foes
sections.body: In Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel sees the danger facing Sylvanas's people. Arthas's legions press them, and remnants of humanity remain their foes. Conventional warfare offers little hope. The Forsaken seek a New Plague that can rot living humans and undead Scourge alike. Renferrel's field research found that arachnid venom from the Skittering Dark, joined with toxins in the hearts of native bears, makes a virulent foundation.

sections.title: Dispatch to the Apothecarium
sections.body: The collected organs and blood from Silverpine's wilderness go beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Royal Apothecary Society's design. He takes Renferrel's samples to test their contaminable properties and refine formulas that may secure Forsaken supremacy across the continent.

faq.q: What is the purpose of collecting bear hearts and spider blood?
faq.answer: Renferrel found that spider blood from the Skittering Dark reacts lethally with toxins in grizzly bear hearts. Together, they give the Royal Apothecary Society raw materials to test and develop the New Plague.
Master Apothecary Faranell heads the Royal Apothecary Society in the Apothecarium quarter of the Undercity. He oversees research into the New Plague on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to create a New Plague?
faq.answer: The Forsaken face the Scourge and the hatred of living humans, with too few soldiers for a long conventional war. Their New Plague is meant to kill both living foes and undead Scourge, securing Forsaken survival and autonomy.
Apothecary Renferrel conducts his research from the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
The Skittering Dark lies northwest of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Giant spiders infest this wilderness, and Renferrel needs their blood.
Yes. Master Apothecary Faranell uses the reagents in further experiments, followed by work in the Apothecarium to refine and test the lethal mixture.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can help the Apothecary Society develop its plague to defend the Forsaken realm against the Scourge and humanity.
As a member of the Horde, you see Forsaken apothecaries pursue victory with virulent concoctions, a grim way of war among the Horde's newest allies.
